         7                  This is another piece of very

        10       Teachers.  It is a piece of legislation that

        11       protects all retired teachers that their

        14                  It's a major piece of legislation.

        15       I would hope that it would be permanent, but

        16       this is a one-year extender.  We've done it

        17       every year.  It passes unanimously.  And it's

        18       very significant.

        19                  I only wish that -- and we're

        20       working on it, to do it for all public

        21       employees and not just teachers.  And that

         6                  I'd just like to echo one thing

         7       that Senator Farley, the sponsor, just

         8       mentioned.  This bill has passed the Assembly

         9       and the Senate, or a comparable bill,

        10       unanimously -- with no negative votes -- for

        12                  Ladies and gentlemen, let's not

        13       play games with our retirees.  Let's not keep

        14       this on the table.  Let's make this a

        15       permanent law so we can stop with the annual

        16       ritual.  It's nice to have a chapter on your

        17       wall every year for something.  Let's do

        18       something for the retirees to give them the

        19       security they deserve long-term.  Let's make

        20       this permanent.

        21                  I'm going to vote yes, but I concur

        22       in the sponsor's suggestion that it is time

        23       for us to make this permanent.
